workarounds.symptom: [NVBug 6900605] Re-enable pathspec for harbor_agent venv so Harbor rollouts stop silently scoring 0
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(harbor_agent): restore pathspec in the Harbor agent environment. Target files: responses_api_agents/harbor_agent/pyproject.toml, responses_api_agents/harbor_agent/tests/test_dependencies.py, responses_api_agents/harbor_agent/uv.lock. Restores `pathspec` in the `harbor_agent` environment. Harbor imports it through `dirhash` → `scantree`, but since #4193 the shared policy excludes it (`pathspec; sys_platform == 'never'`), so `from harbor.job import Job` raises `ModuleNotFoundError` and every Harbor rollout fails and scores 0. (Ref: https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Gym/pull/5732)

workarounds.symptom: [NVBug 6847514] Declare transformers (and ship prompt YAMLs) so ns_tools prepare_dataset runs
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(ns_tools): apply the generic/math prompt in prepare_dataset.py. Target files: resources_servers/ns_tools/prepare_dataset.py, resources_servers/ns_tools/prompts/generic/math.yaml, resources_servers/ns_tools/tests/test_prepare_dataset.py. The ns_tools README command that regenerates the comp-math data now runs and writes the `generic/math` prompt into every row. Before this change it either failed at import (`No module named 'transformers'`) or, with transformers installed, logged a warning per row and silently wrote the r... (Ref: https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Gym/pull/5335)
